lessons.name: nda_mutual_vs_oneway
lessons.description: Counterparty requests mutual NDA instead of one-way
lessons.applies_when: A counterparty asks to convert a standard one-way NDA to a mutual NDA, usually because both sides expect to share confidential information in the discussion (e.g. a partnership or joint pilot, not a pure sales evaluation).
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when only one side will actually share confidential information despite the request -- push back on mutual in that case.

lessons.name: dpa_scc_version_mismatch
lessons.description: DPA / GDPR Standard Contractual Clauses version mismatch
lessons.applies_when: A customer or vendor's proposed Data Processing Addendum references an outdated set of GDPR Standard Contractual Clauses (e.g. the pre-2021 clauses, formally replaced), creating a version mismatch with the current modular 2021 SCCs used going forward.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to jurisdictions using their own local-law equivalent instead of EU SCCs -- that's a different clause set entirely.

lessons.name: liability_cap_negotiation
lessons.description: Limitation-of-liability cap negotiation on an MSA
lessons.applies_when: A counterparty's redline requests raising the standard liability cap (commonly 12 months' fees) or carving out an uncapped exception for a specific risk category such as data breach or confidentiality breach.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to statutorily non-limitable liability (e.g. gross negligence in some jurisdictions), which cannot be capped regardless of negotiating position.

lessons.name: trademark_comarketing_usage
lessons.description: Trademark usage question for co-marketing materials
lessons.applies_when: A partner or reseller wants to use the company's logo/trademark in co-marketing materials, and someone asks whether that's permitted and under what conditions.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when no agreement exists yet -- there, the standard license addendum is required before any usage, not just a guidelines pointer.

lessons.name: contractor_vs_employee_classification
lessons.applies_when: A hiring manager wants to engage someone as an independent contractor, but details of the proposed working arrangement (set hours, company equipment, ongoing exclusive engagement, managed like an employee) raise misclassification risk.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to short, clearly project-scoped, non-exclusive engagements using the contractor's own equipment -- those clear the test easily.

lessons.name: auto_renewal_optout_deadline
lessons.description: Auto-renewal clause opt-out notice deadline tracking
lessons.applies_when: A contract contains an auto-renewal clause requiring notice by a deadline (often 60-90 days before the term end) to opt out, and someone asks either how to track it or, worse, whether the deadline was already missed.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to contracts with no auto-renewal clause, or where renewal is explicitly desired anyway.
